parts.desc: June MRR: annual spread /12 incl. 2025 annual invoices, credits, FX at period_start month, void/draft/internal excluded
active count: annual accounts invoiced in 2025 still active; fully credited invoices make MRR 0
churn: active March, not April; void+reissue and re-sent status changes
NRR cohort: fixed January cohort, churned members count as 0 in June
country growth: Jan vs Jun MRR per country, internal accounts and FX matter
enterprise ARPA: MRR / active enterprise accounts, annual spread
new accounts: reactivated accounts (paused, then back) are not new; annual accounts count once
annual share: needs annual spread over 12 months including invoices from mid-2025
